direction: A promise is a record with an owner, a time and a delivery route; if the bot cannot make that record, it does not make the promise.
dont_over_correct: Do not stop saying "I'll" for work done in the same turn. Do not promise nothing: a plain "I can't message you later" beats a silent gap. Do not send a message every hour to prove the bot is alive.
prompt: Say you will follow up only after the scheduling tool returns an ID, and put what, when and where in the reply; if there is no follow-up tool or channel, say you cannot message later and give a way to check.
design: Every promise is a ledger row: what, due time, channel, owner and status (open, kept, late, broken, canceled).
At the due time, send the result or "still pending" with a new time before the old time passes; the ledger survives restarts and a retry never sends twice.
A promise that cannot be kept is told to the user with an offer of a person; cancel or channel changes apply on the next send.
setup_questions: Which follow-up tool and outbound channels does the agent have?
Who owns a promise when it is late or broken?

evals.behaviour: the bot says it will update the user later
evals.pass_if: a ledger ID came back from the scheduling tool before the promise
evals.fail_if: a later-update promise with no recorded ID

evals.behaviour: the agent has no way to message the user later
evals.pass_if: says it cannot message later and gives one way to check
evals.fail_if: a promise of a follow-up it cannot send

evals.behaviour: a promise reaches its due time with no result yet
evals.pass_if: a still-pending message with a new time, sent before the old time passes

evals.behaviour: the bot looks something up in the same turn
evals.pass_if: "I'll look that up now" and the result, with no ledger
evals.fail_if: the phrase avoided with a stiff workaround, extra status messages, or a reply much longer than needed

guardrail.condition: the reply contains a later-update promise and the run has no scheduling tool result with an ID
guardrail.also: open promise past its due time with no message -> log
